onb.title: Welcome to 貼貼 Tietie
onb.intro:
Tietie remembers the text, images and files you copy. Press {0} to open the list and pick an item to paste it. Text is pasted without formatting.
Everything stays on this computer and is never uploaded.
onb.recordAll: Keep everything, including logins copied from password managers
onb.skipSecret: Don't keep items copied from password managers
mac.onb.passwordNote: Your history stays on this computer, so anyone who can use this computer can see it. If you share or lend this computer, choose the second option. After pasting something sensitive, you can clear it from the menu at the top right. You can change this later in Settings.
win.onb.passwordNote: Your history stays on this computer, so anyone who can use this computer can see it. If you share or lend this computer, choose the second option. After pasting something sensitive, you can clear it from the Tietie icon in the taskbar. You can change this later in Settings.
mac.onb.axNote: For Tietie to paste for you after you pick an item, turn Tietie on under Accessibility in System Settings. Without it, everything still works; you just press ⌘V yourself.
win.onb.trayNote: Tietie lives in the taskbar at the bottom right of your screen. If you can't see it, click the “^” arrow on the taskbar.
launchAtLogin: Start Tietie when I log in

settings.limitNote: When a limit is reached, the oldest items are deleted automatically. Pinned items are never deleted.
mac.settings.passwordNote: Your history stays on this computer and is never uploaded. If you share or lend this computer, consider unchecking this.
mac.settings.lowerTitle: Lowering the limit deletes the oldest items
mac.settings.lowerText: Items over the new limit are deleted right away and can't be restored. Pinned items are never deleted.
win.settings.lowerConfirm: After lowering the limit, older items over the limit will be deleted the next time you copy something (pinned items are kept). Lower the limit?
